name: Harven
description: Domesticated mountain pack beast; compact and shaggy-furred; used for transport and companionship in rugged terrain.
cultural_role: Trusted travel companion and cargo carrier.

name: Zharrel
description: Stealthy forest pack predator with sleek musculature and bioluminescent speckled fur; hunts through coordinated tactics and silent communication.

name: Tharnspinners
description: Small web-weaving arachnids whose patterned silk is culturally revered as a symbol of order and patience.
cultural_role: Symbol of order, patience, and careful making.

name: Veilgliders
description: Nocturnal gliding insectivores with transparent shimmering wings that move silently through the canopy and leave glowing spores behind.
cultural_role: Canopy night-life creature associated with quiet motion.

name: Tharokh
description: Endurance mount of the desert; slender and long-legged with a water-storing ridge; used by nomads for long-distance travel.
cultural_role: Nomad travel mount and endurance symbol.

name: Velshen
description: Armored burrowing moisture-hoarder with spade-like claws; survives by digging deep and conserving water internally.

name: Shavrek
description: Nimble cliff-dwelling forager with powerful hooves and mottled fur.
cultural_role: Mountain forager and cliff adaptation symbol.

name: Mossquill
description: Bee-like mountain pollinator that spreads spores between alpine plants with a soft humming swarm.

name: Rynarth
description: Clever fox-like predator adapted to rocky and wooded slopes.

name: Vroshan
description: Broad-winged high-altitude scavenger whose haunting call echoes across mountain peaks.

name: Brinnek
description: Long-necked migratory grazer moving in striped herds across the plains.
cultural_role: Grassland herd animal and migration marker.

name: Thravic
description: Camouflaged ambush predator that lies hidden in tall grass before striking with precision.
cultural_role: Grassland danger and precision strike symbol.

name: Fennlur
description: Wind-sensitive pack runner that kicks up dust and storm-signals as it moves.
cultural_role: Movement and storm-sense creature in grassland tradition.

name: Vexflit
description: Colorful pollinator bird with bright tail plumes and a musical call, vital to seed spreading and flowering grasses.

name: Grivol
description: Burrowing rodent and ecosystem engineer that stores seeds, aerates soil, and creates shelter for smaller life.

name: Rethal
description: Camouflaged river predator with reflective scales, barbels, and a powerful hidden bite.

name: Lumora
description: Glowing schooling fish that form light-clouds underwater at night.

name: Thryssal
description: Algae-cloaked swamp scavenger that helps purify decaying waters.

name: Braskal
description: Coral-shelled coastal herbivore that forms symbiotic relationships with reef life.

name: Selkari
description: Serpent-like deep-sea guardian, graceful and revered, said to surface during celestial events.
cultural_role: Mythic coastal guardian and sacred ocean figure.
